description: GitHub issue https://github.com/jallum/beadwork/issues/145. showMap (cmd/bw/show.go) computes BLOCKED BY via store.Tips(iss.BlockedBy, rev) + nearestOpen, which climbs the blocker-of-blocker chain (via the reverse edge map) all the way to open root tips, discarding the direct blocker whenever it itself has any blockers of its own -- regardless of whether the direct blocker is open. bw show --json (.blocked_by), bw list ([blocked by: ...]), and bw blocked (Blocked by: ...) all report iss.BlockedBy directly (filtered to non-closed) and agree with each other; bw show's markdown rendering disagrees. Repro: A blocks B blocks C; bw show C should say 'blocked by B' but says 'blocked by A'. Fix: render iss.BlockedBy directly (skipping closed ones), matching list/blocked, dropping the Tips/nearestOpen climb from showMap. Existing tests TestCmdShowTipsDeepChain and TestCmdShowBlockedByClosedTipWalksBack currently assert the buggy climbing behavior as correct and need updating to the direct-blocker contract.
title: [BUG] bw show renders transitive root blockers under BLOCKED BY instead of direct blockers
